description: Create an invoice for a business-client transaction. Use when needing a full invoice document. Do NOT use for calculating totals only; use calculate_totals instead.

business_name.description: The name of the business issuing the invoice

client_name.description: The name of the client receiving the invoice

currency.description: Currency code for the invoice, e.g. USD, EUR

discount_pct.description: Discount rate as a percent, e.g. 10 for 10%

due_in_days.description: Number of days until the invoice is due

items.description: Array of objects, each with name, quantity, and unit_price

notes.description: Any additional notes or comments for the invoice

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate as a percent, e.g. 20 for 20%

name: create_invoice

business_name.description: The name of the business issuing the invoice.

client_name.description: The name of the client receiving the invoice.

currency.description: The currency in which the invoice is denominated.

discount_amount.description: The amount of discount applied to the subtotal.

due_date.description: The date by which the invoice should be paid.

invoice_date.description: The date when the invoice was created.

invoice_number.description: The unique identifier for the invoice.

items.description: The list of items included in the invoice.

description.description: A brief description of the item.

total_price.description: The total price for the quantity of the item.

unit_price.description: The price per unit of the item.

notes.description: Any additional notes or comments related to the invoice.

subtotal.description: The total amount before tax and discount.

tax_amount.description: The amount of tax applied to the subtotal.

total.description: The final amount to be paid, after tax and discount.

title: Create invoice
